licensing: Operator describes free digital books and optional sign-in. No metadata/content redistribution license inferred. Territorial publisher rights, full book reading and reuse remain unverified.
limitations: Observed US/English anonymous default library only; other countries, languages, partner codes and full catalog unverified.
Provider keyword results include matches beyond titles; adapter requires every literal query title token in the returned title. First20 filtered results do not prove catalog-wide absence.
No independent public developer API permission inferred from normal UI requests. Browser initializes its own anonymous session; no tokens, account data or startup bodies stored.
No book contents downloaded; reader access, rights, edition changes and paging remain unverified. Native UUID/version retained.
Book Dash overlap is possible; mirrors and shared content are not additional independent origins.
App-shell policy exception is exact-hash scoped; changed policy, denial or challenge must stop the probe.

analysis_refs.heading: Worldreader / BookSmart recovered
analysis_refs.text: The current operator page links BookSmart’s dashboard. Its policy URL returns an exact generic Angular shell with no REP directives or access challenge; a narrowly hashed review permits only the published anonymous UI. API origins return404 for policy. The privacy notice explicitly makes sign-in optional, and operator documentation describes title/keyword search.

next_action: Maintain anonymous US/English visible title search. Empty/paging, additional territories/languages, reading and reuse rights need separate tests. Preserve old route failures; no production activation.
